strategy_roster.name: Smart Forex System
strategy_roster.notes: Positive one-bar ROC above the documented pseudo-pip threshold 1 and a bullish close proxy the candle-momentum start. Basket averaging, pip grid spacing, lot multipliers, and 30/7/400-pip exits are stateful and not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Straddle Trail
strategy_roster.notes: A close above the prior five-bar high proxies the buy-stop straddle leg; five bars are an explicit fallback. Pending-order pairing, event scheduling, break-even, pip trailing, shutdown commands, and absolute protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: ADX Volume Multiplier
strategy_roster.entry_long: adx(high,low,close,21) > 26 and volume_ratio(volume,20) >= 1.8 and close > ema(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Documented ADX(21)>26 and 1.8x volume are exact; EMA(20) is an explicit proxy for DI+>DI- because directional-index lines are not exposed. The opposite state exits, and the source documents no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Probe
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing 70 proxies a bullish CCI channel break; RSI/level values are fallbacks because the docs supply none. CCI, pending-stop indentation, and pip stop/trailing settings are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Candles XSmoothed
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(14) replaces WMA for smoothed high/low lines; 0.5% is a normalized fallback for the undocumented point buffer. Exact weighting, permissions, opposite exits, and built-in protection are otherwise preserved in intent.

strategy_roster.name: Trade in Channel
strategy_roster.entry_long: high - low <= sma(high - low,20) and low <= donchian_low_prev(low,20) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: A quiet 20-bar range touching prior support with a bullish close approximates a flat lower band and long fade; the pivot branch is omitted. ATR(4) stops, 30-step trailing, and exact previous-pivot/channel state are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Signal Count With Array
strategy_roster.notes: The source is explicitly a Donchian signal-count diagnostic that executes no trades, so the impossible guard preserves that behavior. Offset arrays, sentinel counters, per-candle logging, and ChannelPeriod=24 statistics are outside the trading DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Super Woodies CCI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) zero-level crosses are an explicit proxy for CCI crossing zero; RSI(14) is a fallback because CciPeriod has no value. Exact CCI and timeframe options are unavailable, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Horizontal Line Levels
strategy_roster.notes: The documented strategy is a Level1 alert logger and never submits orders, so the impossible guard preserves no trading. Dynamic bid/ask offsets, timer checks, 50-point levels, and journal alerts require quote/timer state unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Black-Scholes Delta Hedge
strategy_roster.notes: Without an option position, contract data, or defaults for strike/rate/volatility/expiry/side, no deterministic underlying long hedge can be expressed. Black-Scholes pricing, delta, hedge interval, and position accounting are outside the indicator DSL.
